title: Reefer Cargo Services: Carrying Temperature and Atmosphere Ranges
content:
For every tier of Reefer Cargo Services the line publishes a band of carrying temperatures it will run the unit at, and a band of oxygen and carbon dioxide values for the controlled-atmosphere equipment. The figures below are the outer limits of each band; temperatures are in degrees Celsius to one decimal place and gas values are percentages of the container atmosphere.

## Temperature band per tier

| Tier | Coldest set point accepted (°C) | Warmest set point accepted (°C) |
|---|---|---|
| AHL Reefer Standard | -30.0 | 30.0 |
| AHL Reefer Monitored | -30.0 | 30.0 |
| AHL Reefer Cold Treatment | -2.0 | 2.5 |
| AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere | -2.0 | 15.0 |
| AHL Reefer Pharma GDP | 2.0 | 25.0 |
| AHL Reefer Superfreezer | -65.0 | -35.0 |

## Oxygen and carbon dioxide limits per tier

| Tier | Lowest oxygen set point (%) | Highest oxygen set point (%) | Highest carbon dioxide set point (%) |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Reefer Standard | 21.0 | 21.0 | 0.0 |
| AHL Reefer Monitored | 21.0 | 21.0 | 0.0 |
| AHL Reefer Cold Treatment | 21.0 | 21.0 | 0.0 |
| AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere | 2.0 | 10.0 | 15.0 |
| AHL Reefer Pharma GDP | 21.0 | 21.0 | 0.0 |
| AHL Reefer Superfreezer | 21.0 | 21.0 | 0.0 |

On five tiers the lowest and highest oxygen figures coincide at 21.0 and the carbon dioxide ceiling is 0.0, so the band for those tiers contains exactly one oxygen value and exactly one carbon dioxide value. Only AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere opens a genuine range, from 2.0 to 10.0 percent oxygen and up to 15.0 percent carbon dioxide.

## Illustrative look-ups (hypothetical set points)

- A set point of -18.0 °C sits inside the Standard and Monitored bands and outside the other four.
- A set point of 2.0 °C sits inside the Cold Treatment, Controlled Atmosphere and Pharma GDP bands, and also inside Standard and Monitored; it lies at the lower edge of the Pharma GDP band.
- A set point of -40.0 °C sits inside the Superfreezer band alone, being colder than the Standard and Monitored floor of -30.0.
- An oxygen value of 5.0 percent fits only the Controlled Atmosphere band.
